title: Save the Pup
description: Sketch one continuous physics shield in mid-air to shelter an adorable pup from relentless angry honeybees for ten tense seconds.
controls: Hold and drag to draw a single continuous protective line around the dog, then release to test your barrier against the bees.

zh-CN.title: 画线救狗
zh-CN.description: 全球爆火创意物理画线解谜：一笔画出一道坚固防线护住呆萌狗狗，在蜂巢狂蜂猛烈撞击下撑满倒计时即可过关。
zh-CN.controls: 按住屏幕一笔画出保护罩或遮挡墙，松手后线条自动具备物理碰撞，护住狗狗不被蜜蜂蛰到即可。
